Every original receipt remains unchanged. Application identity is established by the complete independently enumerated immutable checkout input bytes, committed-manifest APK record, verified source custom-map outputs and recomputed original build ID. No build or browser measurements are rerun.

limitations: The six-file artifact contains original receipts, not deployed bundle or APK payload bytes. Checkout/runtime input verification and retained output metadata are distinguished explicitly.
One predefined baseline-then-optimized pair is not a statistical hardware benchmark.

Whole-window P95 includes settling time. A longer settling tail can lower that P95 without improving active dragging; the separate raw native-span summaries are descriptive and do not change any acceptance budget.
The comparison preserves all original windows, budgets, profiles, native inputs and EventTiming entries.
Opaque-guard execution requires separate operation-observation evidence; timing receipts do not contain it.
This diagnostic does not replace the full browser gate or actual Android tests on the final candidate.
